Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 720 PM EST Mon Nov 2 2026

- Mild Tuesday with near record high temperatures in the mid to upper
  70s.

- Breezy Tuesday with gusts to around 30 mph possible. 

- Mild conditions continue Wednesday with increasing potential for
  light rain.

&&

.AVIATION...

An elongated area of low pressure stretches from western Ontario to 
the southern Plains, which has been responsible for substantial low 
level moisture transport into the Great Lakes today. MVFR ceilings 
blanket the airspace, while the bulk of IFR ceilings are still over 
IL/IN. LCL heights are expected to steadily lower over the next few 
hours as dewpoints climb and nocturnal cooling takes place, leading 
to a period of IFR potential between 02z and 09z. While isolated 
stations are reporting sub-1000 foot ceilings, it seems it will take 
the arrival of higher dewpoints to become fully entrenched in IFR. 
Arrival of the surface warm front Tuesday morning helps push the low 
level moisture plume north and scatters out restrictions through the 
morning. The scattering trend then continues into the afternoon 
while the pressure gradient gains influence to strengthen southwest 
flow toward 15 knots Tuesday afternoon. 

For DTW... MVFR ceilings persist through early Tuesday morning, with 
a period of IFR ceilings possible due to nocturnal cooling and 
continued moisture advections. A transition back to VFR is then 
expected Tuesday morning with ceilings climbing above 5000 ft for 
the afternoon. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceilings 5000 ft or less tonight. Moderate Tuesday 
  morning becoming low Tuesday afternoon.
